headlines.title: 'Send in the Clowns': Viral video fuels claims Denmark trolled Trump and Rubio
Russian hybrid attacks likely to increase in coming months: Danish intel assessment
With Denmark, Saildrone logs first flag registration for naval surveillance drone
Denmark issues warning over ‘low but growing risk’ of limited Russian attack
Denmark to roll out stun guns nationwide and allocate nearly 800 million DKK from 2027 to expand the police and PET

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Danish intelligence assesses that Russian hybrid attacks are likely to increase in the coming months. [2]
Denmark has warned of a low but growing risk of a limited Russian attack. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR DENMARK
Denmark's net energy import dependency of 38% makes it vulnerable to potential energy disruptions during a period of heightened Russian hybrid activity. [2][E3]

KEY RISKS
Denmark's net energy import dependency of 38% poses a risk of energy supply disruptions amid rising hybrid threats. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on a Danish snap election by December 31 is priced at 7% Yes as of Sep 28, 2026, and closes Jan 1, 2027. [E4]

WATCH ITEMS
It remains to be seen whether the viral video claiming Denmark trolled Trump and Rubio will have diplomatic repercussions. [1]
The outcome of the Polymarket market on a Danish snap election called by December 31 is unresolved. [E4]
